**Project Scope**

We have been tasked with implementing a management system for the Kingston Premier Football League. This should be a console application, and we will be implementing it using C++. 

**In scope**

This application will facilitate storage and entry of the following:

* Teams  
* Player and coach registration  
* Update  
* Search and display  
* Stadium registration (capacity, field condition, ticket price)  
* Fixture creation, with team, stadium, date, and time assignment  
* Match results, league points and standings  
* Ticket sales with capacity monitoring  
* Shop products, transactions, subtotal, GCT, change, and receipts  
* Persistence(save and reload)  
* Producing at least 3 reports, custom exceptions, and a documents test suite

**Out of scope**

We are not required to handle online payments, networking or multi-user access, real-time match data, and a Graphical User Interface (GUI) (this is optional only, and it must not replace the OO design).

**Actors**: League Commissioner, Team Manager/Coach, Match Official, Spectator, Shop Attendant (System operator).

**Non-functional requirements:** data integrity (validate before saving), clear error messages, a menu-driven interface, a file load time under 2 seconds for typical data, and modular code (one .h nd .cpp pair per class).

**Use cases**

| ID | Use case | Actor | Main flow | Alternate / exception flow | Rule(s) |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| UC1 | Register a team | Commissioner | Enter name, parish, reg. number, squad size → system validates → team saved as `Registered` | Duplicate reg. number → `DuplicateEntryException` | Registration |
| UC2 | Add a player to a team | Commissioner / Coach | Select team → enter player details → validate age → add to squad | Age \< 16 → `UnderageException`; squad full → `SquadFullException` | Minimum age |
| UC3 | Create a fixture | Commissioner | Choose home team, away team, stadium, date and time → system checks status and conflicts → fixture saved as `Scheduled` | Team unregistered or suspended → `InvalidTeamStatusException`; double booking → `SchedulingConflictException` | Team status, same-slot rule |
| UC4 | Assign a match official | Commissioner | Select fixture → select official → system checks availability → assigned | Official already on a fixture at that date/time → `SchedulingConflictException` | Official conflict |
| UC5 | Record a match result | Commissioner | Select fixture → enter scores → validate → set `Completed` → update points and standings | Negative score → `InvalidScoreException`; completing without a result → `InvalidFixtureStateException` | Scores, completion |
| UC6 | Sell a ticket | Spectator / Attendant | Select fixture → choose category and quantity → check capacity → issue ticket | Sold-out or over capacity → `CapacityExceededException` | Capacity |
| UC7 | Complete a shop transaction | Attendant | Add products and quantities → compute subtotal, GCT and total → enter payment → compute change → print receipt | Payment \< total → `InsufficientPaymentException`; negative quantity → `InvalidQuantityException` | Payment, quantities |
| UC8 | Save and load data | Commissioner | Choose Save → all collections written to files; Load → files read and objects rebuilt | Missing or corrupt file → `FileIOException` | Persistence |
| UC9 | Generate reports | Commissioner | Choose a report → system displays it (standings, sales, official schedule) | No data → “no records” message | Reports |

**Suggested C++ project layout:** `Person.h/.cpp`, `Player`, `Coach`, `FootballTeam`, `Stadium`, `Fixture`, `Exceptions.h`, `FileManager`, `main.cpp,` and a `tests/` folder (Catch2 or a simple `assert`\-based runner).
